items.label: ASCII codes
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): decimal character codes separated by commas, decoded with gmatch + string.char. The payload is computed by the script, so the sandbox has to be on to read it.

items.label: Hexadecimal
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): hexadecimal digits, decoded with gsub. The payload is computed by the script, so the sandbox has to be on to read it.

items.label: Binary groups
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): eight-digit binary groups, decoded with gmatch and tonumber(x, 2). The payload is computed by the script, so the sandbox has to be on to read it.

items.label: URL escapes
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): percent-escapes for every byte, decoded with gsub. The payload is computed by the script, so the sandbox has to be on to read it.

items.label: Base64
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): base64 text with a decoder written in plain Lua 5.1 arithmetic. The payload is computed by the script, so the sandbox has to be on to read it.

items.label: XOR cipher
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): a repeating-key XOR cipher, the key kept next to the cipher text, xor done with arithmetic. The payload is computed by the script, so the sandbox has to be on to read it.

items.label: Reversed text
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): the program text reversed, put right with string.reverse. The payload is known without running anything.

items.label: Decimal escapes
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): the program as one string literal of decimal escapes. The payload is known without running anything.

items.label: string.char(...)
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): string.char(...) with every code spelled out. The payload is known without running anything.

items.label: Split pieces
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): the program cut into pieces and joined with the concatenation operator. The payload is known without running anything.

items.label: Two layers (base64 around hex)
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): two layers: base64 around the hexadecimal packer around the program. The payload is computed by the script, so the sandbox has to be on to read it.

groups.label: Independent transformations (written for this project)
groups.note: not a real tool: made to test recovery of structure no obfuscator list knows

items.label: Flattened control flow (if / elseif chain)
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): every function and the main chunk become a loop that picks its block by a state number. Nothing has to be run to read it. The structure reader recovers this from the shape of the code alone.

items.label: Flattened control flow (binary search, delta states)
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): the next state is written as a difference from the current one. Nothing has to be run to read it. The structure reader recovers this from the shape of the code alone.

items.label: Flattened control flow (sequential ifs, conditional states)
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): the blocks are one if after the other and the next state is chosen with `cond and A or B`. Nothing has to be run to read it. The structure reader recovers this from the shape of the code alone.

items.label: Strings behind a decoder
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): every string is a call of a decoder over a table of shifted bytes. The strings are computed by a decoder in the script, so the sandbox has to be on to read them. The structure reader recovers this from the shape of the code alone.

items.label: Call proxies and opaque predicates
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): operators and constants behind tiny functions, branches guarded by conditions arithmetic settles. Nothing has to be run to read it. The structure reader recovers this from the shape of the code alone.

items.label: Everything at once, wrapped
items.note: Written for this project (not the output of any real obfuscator): proxies, opaque predicates, flattening, string decoder, renamed locals, wrapper. The strings are computed by a decoder in the script, so the sandbox has to be on to read them. The structure reader recovers this from the shape of the code alone.
